title: ziziphus ruffa
intro: Ziziphus ruffa, commonly known as Jujube, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the Rhamnaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, offering various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Ziziphus ruffa include its ability to improve sleep quality, alleviate anxiety and depression, and regulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
